groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access

rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: unlocks after the Venus to Mercury Junction; gives the Incubator and your first Kubrow

rows.label: free Companion Slot
rows.alt: consign a wrong breed to the Lotus for 25,000 cr

bonuses: The Mercury Junction task gives one free Power Core.

groups.activity: Capture; break every Kubrow Den on Grineer Forest tiles
groups.meta: usually 2-4 dens a map, about 4-5 runs per egg
conditions: Break every den, then abort if no egg dropped.
bonuses: Eggs stack with no cap, so farm several in one sitting.
A max-range Xaku casting The Vast Untime breaks dens you can't see.

rows.label: Incubator Power Core
rows.note: 4,500 Nano Spores, 2 Control Modules, 1 Argon Crystal
rows.alt: first core is free from the Mercury Junction

conditions: The blueprint is a reusable 50,000 cr Market purchase; every incubation consumes a core.
Argon Crystal decays, so build right after farming it.
bonuses: Build several cores ahead; Nano Spores are the real cost of rerolling.

rows.label: Raksa Kubrow
rows.note: random among Huras, Raksa, Sahasa, Sunika, Chesa
rows.alt: two Raksa imprints guarantee the breed

conditions: Each breed is a flat 20% per roll with no pity; the incubation can't be cancelled, and the egg and core are spent whatever comes out.
A new pup stays a puppy until you mature it in the Incubator.
Its Beast Claw gives no Mastery; the companion itself gives 6,000 at rank 30.
bonuses: The Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment halves the wait to 24 hours.
Protect restores 30% of your shields and its own; Hildryn and Harrow players call it close to mandatory.

disclosures.title: imprints
disclosures.body: A Genetic Code Template is a reusable 50,000 cr Market blueprint; each build is 10,000 cr, 700 Nano Spores, 300 Circuits and 1 Control Module. Imprinting a matured Kubrow takes 1.5 hours and the pet is unusable meanwhile. Two imprints of one breed guarantee it, which helps only once you own a Raksa.

disclosures.title: how many rolls
disclosures.body: A rough community expectation is about five eggs and five cores for a random Raksa; players report streaks like four Chesa in a row.
